panels.title: GPUs
panels.description: Cards with a kernel driver bound. A card with no driver has no /sys/class/drm entry and cannot be counted here.

targets.expr: count(count by (driver) (max by (card, driver) (talos_gpu_info{node="$node"}))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Busiest card
panels.description: Highest GPU utilisation right now. Not every driver reports it; amdgpu does.

panels.title: VRAM
panels.description: The fullest card's video memory. VRAM does not page out — a card at 100% fails allocations rather than slowing down.

panels.title: GTT
panels.description: System memory the GPU can address directly, summed over cards.

panels.title: Hottest
panels.description: Warmest GPU reading, and the card it came from.

targets.expr: topk(1, (max by (chip, label, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_celsius{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon"}) * on (chip) group_left (card) max by (chip, card) (max by (chip, pci) (talos_sensor_chip_info{node="$node"}) * on (pci) group_left (card) max by (pci, card) (talos_gpu_info{node="$node"}))) or label_replace((max by (chip, label, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_celsius{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon"}) unless on (chip) max by (chip, card) (max by (chip, pci) (talos_sensor_chip_info{node="$node"}) * on (pci) group_left (card) max by (pci, card) (talos_gpu_info{node="$node"}))), "card", "unknown card", "", ""))

panels.title: Power
panels.description: Power draw reported by the GPU hwmon chips.

panels.title: Utilisation
panels.description: GPU busy percentage. Not every driver reports it; amdgpu does.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Video memory and the system memory the GPU can address. VRAM does not page out — a full card fails allocations rather than slowing down.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Every temperature the card's hwmon chip reports.

targets.expr: max by (chip, label, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_celsius{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon"}) and on (chip) max by (chip) (max by (chip, pci) (talos_sensor_chip_info{node="$node"}) * on (pci) group_left () max by (pci) (talos_gpu_info{node="$node", card="$card"}))

panels.title: Power
panels.description: The reading is instantaneous despite the _average filename, and swings either side of the cap; the cap governs the 5m line, which should sit on it.

targets.expr: max by (chip, label, sensor) (talos_sensor_power_watts{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon"}) and on (chip) max by (chip) (max by (chip, pci) (talos_sensor_chip_info{node="$node"}) * on (pci) group_left () max by (pci) (talos_gpu_info{node="$node", card="$card"}))

avg_over_time((max by (chip, label, sensor) (talos_sensor_power_watts{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon"}) and on (chip) max by (chip) (max by (chip, pci) (talos_sensor_chip_info{node="$node"}) * on (pci) group_left () max by (pci) (talos_gpu_info{node="$node", card="$card"})))[5m:])

max by (chip) (talos_sensor_power_limit_watts{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon", limit="cap"}) and on (chip) max by (chip) (max by (chip, pci) (talos_sensor_chip_info{node="$node"}) * on (pci) group_left () max by (pci) (talos_gpu_info{node="$node", card="$card"}))

panels.title: Clocks
panels.description: Engine and memory clocks. mclk is the physical clock — a card's marketed memory speed is double it.

targets.expr: max by (chip, label, sensor) (talos_sensor_frequency_hertz{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon"}) and on (chip) max by (chip) (max by (chip, pci) (talos_sensor_chip_info{node="$node"}) * on (pci) group_left () max by (pci) (talos_gpu_info{node="$node", card="$card"}))

panels.title: Fan
panels.description: Fan speed against the chip's rated maximum. A line at zero is a stopped fan.

targets.expr: max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_fan_rpm{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon"}) and on (chip) max by (chip) (max by (chip, pci) (talos_sensor_chip_info{node="$node"}) * on (pci) group_left () max by (pci) (talos_gpu_info{node="$node", card="$card"}))

max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_fan_limit_rpm{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon", limit="max"}) and on (chip) max by (chip) (max by (chip, pci) (talos_sensor_chip_info{node="$node"}) * on (pci) group_left () max by (pci) (talos_gpu_info{node="$node", card="$card"}))

panels.title: Cards
panels.description: One row per card. PCI address cross-references the PCI dashboard.

panels.title: Thermals & power
panels.description: GPU temperatures against the chip's own thresholds, attributed to the card that owns the chip.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_join(max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_celsius{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon"}) * on (chip) group_left (card) max by (chip, card) (max by (chip, pci) (talos_sensor_chip_info{node="$node"}) * on (pci) group_left (card) max by (pci, card) (talos_gpu_info{node="$node"})) or ((max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_celsius{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon"}) * 0 + -1) unless on (chip, sensor) (max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_celsius{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon"}) * on (chip) group_left (card) max by (chip, card) (max by (chip, pci) (talos_sensor_chip_info{node="$node"}) * on (pci) group_left (card) max by (pci, card) (talos_gpu_info{node="$node"})))), "key", "/", "chip", "sensor"), "chip", "", "", ""), "sensor", "", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(label_join(max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_limit_celsius{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon"}) or ((max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_celsius{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon"}) * 0 + -1) unless on (chip, sensor) (max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_limit_celsius{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon"}))), "key", "/", "chip", "sensor"), "chip", "", "", ""), "sensor", "", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(label_join(max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_alarm{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon", kind="temperature"}) or ((max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_temperature_celsius{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon"}) * 0 + -1) unless on (chip, sensor) (max by (chip, sensor) (talos_sensor_alarm{node="$node", chip_name=~"amdgpu|nvidia|i915|xe|radeon", kind="temperature"}))), "key", "/", "chip", "sensor"), "chip", "", "", ""), "sensor", "", "", "")
